brief:
Khalil al-Hayya, a senior Hamas official, rejected what he characterized as an equation accepting killing and siege under the terms of an agreement, Shehab Wire reported. He called for an end to silence over what he described as Israeli occupation crimes and disclosed that discussions were underway with Palestinian factions to address mechanisms for dealing with violations.

Al-Hayya's remarks signaled Hamas's position that the accord does not legitimize continued military operations or blockade measures against Palestinians.

title: Hamas leader rejects killing and siege under ceasefire accord
